answerable.q: How many casual leaves do I get in a year?
answerable.evidence: 12 casual leaves per calendar year

answerable.q: Do unused casual leaves roll over?
answerable.evidence: Casual leaves cannot be carried forward

answerable.q: When do I need a doctor's note for being off sick?
answerable.evidence: A medical certificate from a registered practitioner is mandatory

answerable.q: How much notice must I give before taking earned leave?
answerable.evidence: Earned leave must be applied at least 5 working days in advance

answerable.q: What happens to earned leave above the carry-forward cap?
answerable.evidence: Accumulated earned leave beyond 30 days will be encashed

answerable.q: How many weeks off does a mother get for her third baby?
answerable.evidence: For the third child onwards, the entitlement is 12 weeks

answerable.q: Can a new father split his time off into two parts?
answerable.evidence: cannot be split across multiple instances

answerable.q: How many days off if my grandmother dies?
answerable.evidence: 2 days of bereavement leave are available

answerable.q: Does taking unpaid leave affect my bonus?
answerable.evidence: may impact annual performance ratings and bonus eligibility

answerable.q: How long is the probation period?
answerable.evidence: probation period of 6 months

answerable.q: What notice is needed to leave while on probation?
answerable.evidence: notice period of 15 days

answerable.q: How many years of past employment are verified?
answerable.evidence: employment history verification for the last 5 years

answerable.q: What happens if I don't hand in my joining documents?
answerable.evidence: withholding of the first salary disbursement

answerable.q: Are interns entitled to employee benefits?
answerable.evidence: Interns are governed by a separate internship policy

answerable.q: What are the core hours?
answerable.evidence: Core working hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM

answerable.q: How many days a week must I come to the office?
answerable.evidence: at least 3 days per week

answerable.q: I forgot to mark attendance. How long do I have to correct it?
answerable.evidence: must be requested within 7 calendar days

answerable.q: What is the overtime rate?
answerable.evidence: 1.5x the standard hourly rate

answerable.q: What share of CTC is basic pay?
answerable.evidence: Basic Pay (40% of CTC)

answerable.q: When is payday?
answerable.evidence: last working day of every month

answerable.q: What is the maximum bonus percentage?
answerable.evidence: 8% to 25% of the annual basic salary

answerable.q: How much does the company put into PF?
answerable.evidence: contributes 12% of the employee's basic salary

answerable.q: Can I add my parents to the medical cover?
answerable.evidence: add parents as dependents at an additional premium

answerable.q: After how many years do I qualify for gratuity?
answerable.evidence: completed 5 years of continuous service

answerable.q: What rating do I need to get promoted?
answerable.evidence: minimum rating of 4 in the last two

answerable.q: How long does a PIP last?
answerable.evidence: structured 60-day program

answerable.q: What should I wear to a client meeting?
answerable.evidence: formal business attire is expected

answerable.q: Do I have to say that opinions I post online are my own?
answerable.evidence: must include a disclaimer that views are personal

answerable.q: Who sits on the committee that handles harassment complaints?
answerable.evidence: two internal members, and one external member from an NGO

answerable.q: How soon does the ICC start an inquiry after a complaint?
answerable.evidence: initiate an inquiry within 7 working days

answerable.q: How long can a harassment inquiry take to finish?
answerable.evidence: The inquiry will be completed within 60 days

answerable.q: What is the notice period for someone in Band 5?
answerable.evidence: 60 days for employees in Band 4 and above

answerable.q: Can I pay to leave earlier than my notice period?
answerable.evidence: may request a notice period buy-out

answerable.q: When will my final settlement be paid after I leave?
answerable.evidence: within 45 days of the employee's last working day

answerable.q: Is the exit interview compulsory?
answerable.evidence: Participation is voluntary

answerable.q: How fast does HR acknowledge a grievance?
answerable.evidence: acknowledge the grievance within 2 working days

answerable.q: Who do I go to if I disagree with how HR resolved my issue?
answerable.evidence: escalate the matter to the Head of HR

answerable.q: Can I ask HR to delete my personal information?
answerable.evidence: request deletion of their personal data

answerable.q: How long does the NDA apply after I quit?
